description: This source file implements the PlayerInfo class and related functions for managing player properties, Dolby modes, and callbacks within the Thunder namespace. It includes functions for registering callbacks, querying capabilities, and controlling Dolby audio modes.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Manages player properties, Dolby modes, and callback registration within the Thunder namespace. Implements singleton pattern and interfaces for interacting with player state and capabilities.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class implementing the INotification interface for Dolby output, used to handle Dolby sound mode updates.

methods.name: PlayerInfoStatus
methods.description: Converts a core status code to a playerinfo_status_t enum value.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PlayerInfo.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Deletes the singleton instance of PlayerInfo.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the callsign name of the player.

methods.name: RegisterOperationalStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for operational state changes.

methods.name: UnregisterOperationalStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for operational state changes.

methods.name: RegisterDolbyAudioModeChangedCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for Dolby audio mode updates.

methods.name: UnregisterDolbyAudioModeChangedCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for Dolby audio mode updates.

methods.name: IsAudioEquivalenceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if audio equivalence is enabled.

methods.name: IsAtmosMetadataSupported
methods.description: Checks if Atmos metadata is supported.

methods.name: DolbySoundMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current Dolby sound mode.

methods.name: playerinfo_dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the PlayerInfo singleton instance.
